terminals.name: claxedo-server
terminals.description: Self-hosted Claxedo control plane (embedded OpenCode engine + SQLite) on http://127.0.0.1:2593 -- the backend the web app talks to. Needs the .nvmrc-pinned Node for the embedded engine's node:sqlite driver. If OPENCODE_ZEN_API is set, it is wired to the in-process engine as the 'opencode' (OpenCode Zen) provider (the engine-auth bridge does not cover this provider, so OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT is the supported path).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; [ -n "$OPENCODE_ZEN_API" ] && export OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT="{\"opencode\":{\"type\":\"api\",\"key\":\"$OPENCODE_ZEN_API\"}}"; cd packages/claxedo-server && bun run dev

terminals.name: claxedo-app
terminals.description: Claxedo web app (Solid + Vite dev server) on http://localhost:4444, proxying API routes to the control plane on 2593.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/node/bin:$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd packages/claxedo-app && bun run dev
